units: executed instructions/sample; not modeled cycles or measured chip timing
conditions: Identical two-core tone/transient input, X:0 stereo audio, null stub subtracted per split/core, complete control endpoint/turn/type schedule from benchmark_reverbs.knobs; finite observed maxima only.
